scenes.basis: 8:1 "A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem"
8:5 "Philip went down to the city of Samaria, and proclaimed to them the Christ"

8:26 "Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert" - the desert-road scene names no place with a node; Jerusalem and Gaza are the road's endpoints, never reached
8:40 "But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities"
